summary: Tested Phase-2 Daily Digest + fixed AI Assistant chat. Backend 8/8 pytest passing (assistant chat static + live tools, digest GET/PUT config persistence, preview shape, send-now with saved config, auth guards). Frontend end-to-end verified via Playwright: owner login → /biz/digest → preview metrics render (Revenue Today, Orders, Avg Ticket, Staff on Duty) → digest-ai-text populated with real AI copy → email recipient add + Enabled toggle + Save shows 'Digest settings saved' toast → Send preview now completes without error → floating AI Assistant on the digest page returns a proper 'How do I add a menu item?' answer (no 'Sorry — I couldn't answer' message).

issues: Adding the same email twice via the input+Add button silently creates a duplicate entry in email_recipients — consider dedup on add, or backend PUT could dedupe. Minor UX polish.

action_items: Optional: dedupe email/sms recipient lists on add (frontend) or on PUT (backend).
Optional: also add a data-testid on the login form's 'Sign in' button confirmation state; existing dash-submit-btn works fine.
critical_code_review_comments: digest.py: _do_send() uses tenant name safely and always updates last_sent_at, good. Scheduler dedupes by last_sent_at.startswith(YYYY-MM-DD) — correct.
assistant.py: budget-exceeded errors now raise HTTP 402 with a clear detail; generic upstream failures raise 502. Good.
Duplicate emails: PUT /api/digest/config accepts arbitrary list — consider server-side dedup + basic email format validation via Pydantic EmailStr.
digest.py imports internal helpers from routes.assistant; keeps single source of truth for live tenant data. Nice.
